quotes.text: Fixed ``_weighted_percentile`` with ``average=True`` so zero-weight samples just before the end of the array are handled correctly.
Check zero weights just before `max_index` handled correctly.

summary: `_weighted_percentile` is a helper scikit-learn uses to compute percentiles when samples have weights (for example in `KBinsDiscretizer` and some metrics). With `average=True`, a sample with weight zero just before the end of the array was handled wrongly, so adding a sample that should count for nothing changed the result. The test the fix added compares the percentile of [1, 3] with the percentile of [1, 2, 3] where 2 has weight 0: the two should be equal.
teaches: Edge cases in a numerical helper
title: Zero weights at the end of a weighted percentile

whereToLook.hint: The `average=True` part, where it chooses the next index after a percentile.
